seo.title: Tank Surface Area Calculator - Insulation Painting
seo.description: Calculate external surface area of cylindrical tanks for paint, insulation, and heat loss estimation.

formula.explanation: Surface area = 2πr² (top+bottom) + πD×L (shell). For open-top tanks, subtract one circular end.

content.introduction: Calculate the total external surface area of a closed-top vertical cylindrical tank (including roof and floor). Used for estimating paint quantities, insulation area, and external heat transfer.

example.description: 3m × 6m tank: shell 56.5 m² + roof/floor 14.1 m² = 70.7 m² total.

faq.q: How much paint do I need?
faq.a: Industrial epoxy covers 6-8 m² per liter at standard dry film thickness. For 70.7 m² with 2 coats: ~18-24 liters.
Surface area increases with insulation O.D. — add 2× insulation thickness to diameter for exterior surface. For 50mm insulation on 3m tank, use 3.1m effective diameter.
